title: Best Accounting Software for Freelancers 2026
description: A comparison of accounting tools designed for self-employed professionals and freelancers, covering FreshBooks, QuickBooks Self-Employed, Wave, Xero, and Zoho Books.
body:
Freelancers and self-employed professionals have distinct accounting needs that differ from small businesses and enterprises. Invoicing, expense tracking, tax estimation, and mileage tracking are the core requirements, while inventory management, payroll, and multi-user access are rarely needed.

This comparison evaluates five accounting platforms tailored for freelancers and independent professionals. None of the platforms have published pricing verification data, so check each vendor's current pricing page for exact rates.

## FreshBooks

FreshBooks is the leading accounting platform for service-based freelancers. Its invoicing-first design makes it intuitive for professionals who bill by the hour or project, and its automation capabilities reduce the time spent on administrative tasks.

FreshBooks' invoicing features include customizable invoice templates, recurring invoices, automatic payment reminders, and late payment fees. The platform also provides expense tracking with receipt capture via mobile app, time tracking that seamlessly flows into invoices, and project profitability reporting.

The platform's per-client pricing model is advantageous for freelancers with a manageable client base. Solo professionals with under twenty active clients find FreshBooks' pricing efficient, while freelancers with high client volume should evaluate whether per-client costs scale favorably.

Check FreshBooks' current pricing page for exact rates.

## QuickBooks Self-Employed

QuickBooks Self-Employed is Intuit's dedicated offering for freelancers. It provides simplified accounting focused on the specific needs of independent professionals, including income and expense tracking, mileage logging, and quarterly tax estimation.

The platform's mileage tracking feature automatically logs drives using GPS, categorizes them as business or personal, and calculates the standard mileage deduction. Quarterly tax estimation helps freelancers set aside the right amount for estimated tax payments.

QuickBooks Self-Employed integrates with TurboTax for seamless tax filing at year end, and with QuickBooks for freelancers who plan to grow into a small business with payroll and employees.

Check QuickBooks Self-Employed's current pricing page for exact rates.

## Wave

Wave offers free accounting software for freelancers and very small businesses, generating revenue through payment processing fees. Its pricing model eliminates software subscription costs entirely for freelancers who can accept Wave's payment processing rates.

Wave's accounting features include unlimited invoicing, receipt scanning, expense tracking, and basic financial reporting. The platform also provides personalized support from bookkeeping and accounting professionals at additional cost.

Wave is best suited for freelancers with low transaction volume who want to minimize software expenses. As freelancers grow their client base and transaction volume, they may find that Wave's payment processing fees exceed the subscription cost of paid platforms.

Check Wave's current pricing page for exact rates.

## Xero

Xero offers a more comprehensive accounting platform that scales from freelancers to growing businesses. Its Early tier provides invoicing, expense tracking, and bank reconciliation at a competitive price point.

Xero's advantages for freelancers include unlimited users on all plans, which is valuable for freelancers who work with a bookkeeper or accountant. The platform's app marketplace provides integrations for time tracking, project management, and payment processing.

Xero's Early plan includes bank reconciliation for up to twenty transactions per month, which may be insufficient for high-volume freelancers. The Growing plan eliminates transaction limits but at a higher monthly cost.

Check Xero's current pricing page for exact rates.

## Zoho Books

Zoho Books offers a free plan for freelancers with invoicing, expense tracking, and bank reconciliation for basic needs. Its paid plans add automation, project management, and advanced reporting features.

Zoho Books' free plan is among the most generous in the accounting software market, supporting one user and standard accounting features at no cost. The platform's integration with the broader Zoho ecosystem provides access to CRM, project management, and collaboration tools.

Zoho Books is ideal for freelancers who want a free starting point with the option to scale into paid features as their business grows. The platform's annual billing discounts reduce monthly costs further.

Check Zoho Books' current pricing page for exact rates.

## Selection Guidance

The right accounting platform for freelancers depends on billing model, client volume, and growth plans. FreshBooks is best for service-based freelancers who bill by hour or project. QuickBooks Self-Employed is ideal for freelancers focused on mileage tracking and tax estimation. Wave suits freelancers who want free software and can manage payment processing costs. Xero and Zoho Books provide scalable options for freelancers planning business growth.
